name: Jessica Hische
bio: Jessica Hische is a lettering artist and New York Times best-selling author based in Oakland. Public site jessicahische.is documents client lettering, books, and the well-known Should I Work for Free flowchart. Practice centers on typographic craft and thoughtful freelance boundaries.
highlights: Lettering artist with widely taught freelance craft resources.
Public teaching of typographic taste and client craft.
